newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were narrowly mixed in the after-hours session on Monday, after the market rose slightly during the day, backed by news an increase in rubber stocks was smaller than initial forecasts, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen per kg lower to 0.4 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark March contract was 0.2 yen weaker at 132.4 yen. Volume was 6,291 lots.

"Stock news announced in the afternoon, fuelled moderate short-covering rally during the day. But the upside potential may be limited in the near-term on views that stocks have not reached their ceiling," one trader said.
